identity.name: Seeds — Idea Incubator
identity.description: Seeds are raw ideas collected by Scout Agent or proposed by Gardener/SR. Managed by PROTO-011 (Seed-to-Work Protocol). Each seed goes through: inbox → evaluation → root → work.

meta.description: Seeds are raw, unprocessed ideas. They are the entry point for all new concepts in Mandala. Managed by PROTO-011.
meta.how_to_use: SR reads seeds, evaluates them, promotes best to root, then to works.

inbox.description: Raw seeds from Scout Agent or manual input. Status: raw.

root.description: Promoted seeds that passed evaluation. Status: evaluated.

archive.description: Seeds that have been converted to works.

evaluation_criteria.description: 4 criteria used in Phase 1 (Inbox) of PROTO-011
